message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"data[0] / size","code":"if (size == 0) return 0; uint8_t decider = data[0]; size -= 1; data += 1;","note":"The first byte is attacker-controlled but ignored by the target logic; the remaining bytes become the file contents written to disk."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"data,size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"The remaining input bytes are copied verbatim into a temporary file, so the attacker fully controls the HDF5 file image."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"filename","code":"H5Fopen(filename, H5F_ACC_RDONLY, H5P_DEFAULT);","note":"The crafted file is parsed by HDF5 in read-only mode, entering the object-header and message decoding paths."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5S.c","function":"H5S_read","line":1117,"var":"ds->extent","code":"if (NULL == H5O_msg_read(loc, H5O_SDSPACE_ID, &(ds->extent)))","note":"Opening a dataset causes HDF5 to read the dataspace message from the object header into ds->extent."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Omessage.c","function":"H5O_msg_read_oh","line":513,"var":"oh->mesg[idx].native","code":"H5O_LOAD_NATIVE(f, 0, oh, &(oh->mesg[idx]), NULL)","note":"If the dataspace message has not yet been decoded, HDF5 invokes the H5O_SDSPACE_ID decode callback on attacker-controlled raw bytes."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Opkg.h","function":"<global>","line":163,"var":"MSG->raw_size / MSG->raw","code":"(MSG_type->decode)((F), (OH), (MSG)->flags, &ioflags, (MSG)->raw_size, (MSG)->raw)","note":"The decoder receives the raw message buffer and its declared size; malformed length fields can make later reads go past the allocated raw buffer."},
 {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Osdspace.c","function":"H5O__sdspace_decode","line":111,"var":"p / p_size / sdim->rank","code":"const uint8_t *p_end = p + p_size - 1; ... sdim->rank = *p++; ... if (p + (sizeof_size * sdim->rank - 1) > p_end) HGOTO_ERROR(...)","note":"The dataspace decoder walks attacker-controlled bytes and uses the declared rank and size fields to bound later reads; a corrupted message can defeat these assumptions and drive an out-of-bounds read."},
 {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Osdspace.c","function":"H5O__sdspace_decode","line":136,"var":"sdim->size[i] / sdim->max[i]","code":"for (i = 0; i < sdim->rank; i++) H5F_DECODE_LENGTH(f, p, sdim->size[i]);","note":"The sink is the length-decoding loop, which reads bytes from the raw message buffer into the dataspace extent fields and is the site of the heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
print('updated trace')
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
